caption: The drawing shows three views of the same pair of earrings, rendered on a beige background. Each earring is depicted with a gold-colored wire forming the hook and a frame, which loops into decorative spirals at the top. The main body of the earrings is elongated and oval-shaped with a black-colored surface. In the center of the oval shape, there is a circular, faceted gem, represented with shades of white and gray to indicate reflection and transparency in the left view, and with simpler highlights in the middle and side view. At the bottom of each earring, a small, pointed gold and reddish-brown triangular element is attached. The top of the earrings features another black element resembling a small, stylized bow or leaf, accentuated with gold trim. The drawing provides both a front view, a three-quarters view, and a side profile of the earring, all arranged against a plain beige rectangular bordered area with no additional embellishments or background details.
title: Earrings
